scope: Curated Champion doubles teams, imported-team shared paths, and explicitly supported simulator mechanics

inventories.scope: Distinct moves used by shipped teams
known_gaps: Eleven baseline moves have metadata but insufficient dedicated behavior evidence.

inventories.scope: Abilities used by curated teams and registered Champion Mega forms
known_gaps: The curated inventory is modeled, but it does not cover every importable ability or every ability interaction.

inventories.scope: Species/forms represented by generated Showdown data and shipped runtime teams
known_gaps: Not every import-enabled species/form has an executable battle-stat and transformation fixture.

inventories.scope: Held items used by shipped and imported teams
known_gaps: No complete item behavior registry reconciles all import-enabled items to executable interaction tests.

inventories.scope: Moves, abilities, items, species, and forms accepted through team imports
known_gaps: Import legality coverage is broader than locally verified battle behavior coverage.

families.name: Pokemon identity, items, switching, bench, fainting, and replacement
Priority brackets, effective Speed, Trick Room, ties, and doubles ordering
known_gaps: Scoped same-turn Tailwind and one complete-game fixture agree with the pinned reference; arbitrary mid-turn Speed changes, changed exact ties and official Champions confirmation remain unproved.

families.name: Base stats, Champion SP, natures, stages, forms, and effective battle stats
known_gaps: The complete legal species and form inventory is not represented by executable stat fixtures.

families.name: Damage pipeline, typing, STAB, spread, critical, weather, terrain, and modifier order
known_gaps: Oracle fixtures cover selected supported moves and modifier combinations, not the complete Showdown interaction space.
Seismic Toss isolated damage/immunity/Protect probes agree locally; broader fixed-damage interactions and Champions-specific approval remain unproved.

families.name: Move metadata, accuracy, recoil, contact, secondary effects, multi-hit, and failure behavior
known_gaps: Imported legal moves may be baseline-supported without dedicated local behavior fixtures.
Growl, Leer and the declared PP/Pressure boundaries have scoped pinned-reference proof, but the wider status-stage and move-resource interaction inventory remains incomplete.

families.name: Ability activation, suppression, targeting, damage, priority, and entry effects
known_gaps: The curated and Mega inventory is modeled, but the full legal ability inventory and all interaction orders are not covered.

families.name: Held-item activation, consumption, choice locks, defensive effects, and ownership continuity
known_gaps: The complete legal item inventory and all item-ability-move interaction orders are not covered.

families.name: Major status, volatile status, immunities, duration, denial, and end-of-turn effects
known_gaps: Leftovers/Toxic ordering and rounding have bounded doubles parity. Full residual event ordering, lethal boundaries, Heal Block expiry and mixed recovery remain unproved.

families.name: Weather, terrain, screens, Tailwind, Trick Room, and field duration
Doubles targeting, redirection, adjacency, spread resolution, and no-valid-target paths
known_gaps: Per-target spread accuracy is covered, but immunity-before-accuracy and mixed-target interaction ordering remain unproved.

families.name: Mega activation, runtime form changes, and supported Tera behavior
Champion legality and shared mechanics for bundled and imported teams
Seeded whole-battle traces, termination, outcomes, and curated matchup stability
Champion-specific rules and Regulation M-B differences
known_gaps: Required official or captured Regulation M-B evidence is incomplete, so Showdown baseline behavior cannot be promoted as Champion truth.

families.name: All legal move, ability, item, species, field, and timing combinations
known_gaps: The interaction space is combinatorial and no exhaustive state-space or differential oracle runner exists.
